description: Runs any tool of the AICTIONBOT™ Werkbank by its name with its arguments, including tools that are not in this endpoint's core list. Find the name and the input fields with find_tool first. Licence rules are the same as calling the tool directly.

arguments.description: Arguments for that tool, as described by its input fields.

name.description: Tool name as returned by find_tool, e.g. check_bank_change.

name: run_tool
title: Run any AICTIONBOT™ Werkbank tool by name
